narrative.details:
Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.

You must see Grif Wildheart in Kharanos. He can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.
narrative.offerRewardText: Yes, I do believe you are ready, as well....
